elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Clause c expressly requires TrueLink to “defend, indemnify and hold Client and its affiliates harmless.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Clause c covers Client and its affiliates against “any third-party claim” arising from the specified events.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause c(i) covers allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause c(ii) expressly covers TrueLink’s breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause c(iii) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause c(iv) expressly covers TrueLink’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of any claim under Section 12.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is given control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Clause a limits Client’s indemnity to Client Content and Client’s violation of applicable state or federal law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Clause c covers Client against third-party claims alleging that the Interface, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is stated, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is stated, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is stated, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no refund remedy tied to the unavailability of procure, modify, or replace remedies.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
